about_the_game:
SpelBrawl is a fast-paced roguelite word game that combines strategy, skill, and a dash of luck. Every round challenges you to craft words, rewarding clever plays and sharp thinking with powerful upgrades for every challenge you complete.

Face the challenge solo and unlock an arsenal of game-changing items: cast devastating spells, use intervals to shift the game in your favor, and unlock unique characters that can extend your words in unexpected ways. Along the way, you’ll discover a variety of surprises to keep every run fresh and exciting.

Push your limits and claim the highest score every round!

Use the reroll spell to reshape the game in your favor!

Chain multipliers to skyrocket your score!

Conquer the challenge by completing the items on the To-Do list!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics or equivalent with Mesa 20+
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th gen) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce MX110 or equivalent (Mesa/NVIDIA 470+)
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • Sound Card: Standard built-in
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple GPU or AMD Radeon R9 M370X or better
  • Sound Card: Standard built-in

short_description: SpelBrawl is a roguelite word game with challenging and rewarding gameplay. Play solo to unlock spells, intervals, and unique characters to extend words. Battle others online and test your luck to become the ultimate SpelBrawler!
